text:
mira: Heads up: we're seeing tokenization divergence between SDK 2.8.0 and runtime 3.3.0 for model gptx2 on long prompts. Plan: pin runtime 3.3.0 for gptx2 in a phased manner (canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%) tonight 02:00 UTC with routing fallback to gptx2-quant if errors spike.

eng-sre: do we have a repro? what's the failure mode?

mira: repro attaches: tokenizer emits different split causing trailing function-call tokens to shift. Not crashing, but generation mismatches and some downstream functions mis-parse. Example diff below:

```
input: "Summarize the following: [very long doc...]"
expected tokens tail: "...,
]"
observed tokens tail: "...,]"  // missing newline token leads to parse mismatch
```

samir: risky if customer workflows rely on function call offsets. Suggest start with 1% canary in eu-west, run eval suite and verify function-call alignment metrics.

ops_jun: agree. I'll schedule deploy-bot to pin with canary policy and attach a telemetry alert. Deploy-bot, prepare jobs and post IDs.

deploy-bot: command received: `pin runtime 3.3.0 --model gptx2 --canary 1% --regions eu-west --note "tokenizer divergence mitigation"`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6161117001). Will report progress.

eng-qa: we'll run the function-call offset test on canary 1 and compare hashes. ETA 12m after job completion. Test script attached: ```
# offset-check.sh
python tests/offset_check.py --model gptx2 --endpoint https://canary.eu-west.api --runs 50
```

support_bot: auto-notify: @support notified (ticket template prepped) with advisory draft.

deploy-bot: canary job complete (job=JB6161117001) 02:07 UTC 0status=OK

eng-qa: canary results: 50 runs, 3 mismatches (6%). Baseline expectation <1% for production. Mismatches are function-call offset shifts by 1 token. Saving artifacts to QC-3377.

mira: that's above threshold. Do not proceed to 10%. Rollback/pin revert? Wait 0we pinned runtime to 3.3.0; reverting means unpin to previous runtime version per region. Proposal: rollback canary immediately and run a hotfix to SDK tokenizer so it matches runtime.

samir: agree on rollback. Rollback criteria: any functional mismatch >1% or user-visible function-call failures. Also block if any 5xx or user error rate increases.

ops_jun: deploy-bot, run revert in eu-west and update jobs.

deploy-bot: revert command received: `unpin runtime 3.3.0 --model gptx2 --regions eu-west --mode force`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6161117002).

deploy-bot: revert complete (job=JB6161117002) 002:25 UTC 0status=OK

eng-sre: telemetry confirms function-offset error rates back to baseline, no 5xx spikes.

samir: I'm drafting release note and postmortem blurb: "We attempted a phased pin of runtime 3.3.0 for gptx2 to address tokenizer drift. Canary telemetry showed function-call offset regressions for a small subset of long prompts. We reverted the pin in eu-west and will ship an SDK tokenizer parity fix. No customer-facing incidents observed."

mira: add mitigation steps for customers using function-calls: recommend pinning SDK 2.7.x client or using query-time header `x-runtime-fallback=gptx2-quant` until fix ships.

support_bot: posted advisory draft to #support-drafts and tagged @support.

ops_jun: hold night window for full rollout until SDK patch is ready. Closing this thread once we have the SDK PR and CI green.

eng-qa: filed QC-3377 with repro details and include a failing example request for the SDK team.

mira: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene here once the SDK patch CI is green and we have a new canary plan.
